svg.aria-label: The datom workflow, beat by beat: an analyst sets up a git repo for the code and a store for the data; syncs two new files; a second analyst clones the code and syncs next month's extract, where one file is unchanged and skipped, one changed and one new; a reader reads version 1 from storage alone

foreignObject.div:
brings the code,
not the data

storage alone:
no git, no PAT
